acts: Holding yourself up takes more than you are taking in.
Start one weekly session that builds your strength, like swimming or climbing.
Grow one plant from seed and give it water each morning.
Hand one errand to someone else this month and leave it with them.
Close one open project this week and say it is done.
Let someone else set the end point for one plan.
Let the rough version out.
Play an unfinished song to one friend.
Post the drawing with the mistake left in.
Bring one thing you made to the next gathering of friends.
Listen to one album from start to finish.
Wait three days before you share your next idea.
The ground under your plans is thinner than they need.
Pick one goal for the season and give it the same hour each week.
Tell one friend about it and ask them to check on you in a month.
Start each week with one thing that is only for you.
Say no to one request before you say yes again.
Join one class that meets at a set time.
Clear out one drawer and keep only what you use.
Fix a weekly time with a friend to train or practise together.
Give one evening a week to learning something nobody grades.
Take one whole day this month with no plan and no messages.
Ask one person who knows more than you and wait for the whole reply.
Take one free course on a subject that is new to you.
Leave one hard question open for a week before you answer it.
No amount of knowing decides for you.
Bring one half-done task to the end this week.
Fix one broken thing with your own hands.
